title: Rathuum/Quotes
kind: 場所・ミッション・その他

lines: - Kela De Thaym: "Listen up scum. Idiots, rotting freaks of our great war machine!"
- Kela De Thaym: "Captured deserters have cried for Rathuum. Do you know what that means? Trial by combat!"
- Kela De Thaym: "Confused? It's simple: should he live, innocent. Should he die, guilty! This court is now in session!"
- Kela De Thaym: "Grineer Executioners do your worst."
- Kela De Thaym: "Down you go. I'd say better luck next time, but you's dead."
- Kela De Thaym: "Ouch, that can't feel good."
- Kela De Thaym: "Snake, a couple more hits to the face and you look just like my audience."
- Kela De Thaym: "The Executioners have fumbled. Typical."
- Kela De Thaym: "Come on, Executioners, this is all you've been good at, don't mess it up."
- Kela De Thaym: "Our Executioners are crushing dung snakes into soup!"
- Kela De Thaym: "Our Executioners near their final judgment."
- Kela De Thaym: "Victory nears for the Executioners!"
- Kela De Thaym: "That Executioner's a mean one, downright brutal. Makes me smile."
- Kela De Thaym: "Hear that, Executioners? They're cheering for you."
- Kela De Thaym: "What a performance. I can feel your hunger, like you want to rip that condender's throat with your teeth."
- Kela De Thaym: "You greedy bunch of savages. This is all you ever wanted isn't it?"
- Kela De Thaym: "All you Grineer are sick in the head. I do respect that."
- Kela De Thaym: "You wall-hugging clone monkeys can't get enough, can you?"
- Kela De Thaym: "Did you like that? Let's hear it for our Executioners!"
- Kela De Thaym: "Hear that, snakes? You got an audience and they wanna see you bleed."
- Kela De Thaym: "The Tenno... I was expecting... I don't know... more."
- Kela De Thaym: "Come on, Tenno, you're like a Corpus drone with a dead battery, you ain't getting no air time."
- Kela De Thaym: "Really now, Tenno? My Roller balls are sharper than you."
- Kela De Thaym: "Where do you think you are? Your Dojo? This is Rathuum."
- Kela De Thaym: "You'll never win your case, Tenno. Not like that."
- Kela De Thaym: "You're wasting the court's time, Tenno."
- Kela De Thaym: "This isn't basic training; this is Rathuum. Get out there and deliver your judgment."
- Kela De Thaym: "Watching this one fight is like watching a fly trying to swat a lion."
- Kela De Thaym: "No, no, no. Just stop and die. You're wasting this court's time."
- Kela De Thaym: "Justice has been served. Prepare the accused for death."
- Kela De Thaym: "You see? The system works."
- Kela De Thaym: "Justice is blind and now so are you."

- Kela De Thaym: "Grineer! You always knew it and now there's proof. The Tenno are cheaters! And I hold them in contempt! The accused will be executed the old fashioned way. Bound and shackled. And don't worry, I'll let all of you flend-stained sadists watch that too!"
